# John Telfer (of Castleton)

**John Telfer** was a Scottish farmer from Castleton parish, Roxburghshire, in the Liddesdale valley. He is the earliest confirmed ancestor in the direct Telfer line.

## Vital Details

- **Born:** ~1715–1735 (estimated — exact date unknown), Castleton, Roxburghshire, Scotland
- **Died:** Unknown
- **Spouse:** Elspeth Young (m. unknown, ~1750s)
- **Occupation:** Likely farmer or shepherd in Castleton parish

## Known Children

| Child | Born/Baptised | Notes |
|-------|--------------|-------|
| **James Telfer (1761–1845)** | Baptised 14 Jul 1761, Castleton | Baptised to John Telfer & Elspeth Young at Castleton. Married Betty Hutton (1776–1853). Father of Francis Telfer (1809–1895). |

> **Note:** Other children may exist — the Castleton OPRs (1697–1819) are on microfilm at FamilySearch (batch C11865-1) and ScotlandsPeople but have not been fully searched for this family.

## ⚠️ Research Gaps

- **No birth or baptism record found** for John Telfer. The Castleton OPR begins in 1697; John may appear in it, but this requires a direct search of the registers.
- **No marriage record found** for John Telfer & Elspeth Young. The Castleton marriage registers begin in 1759 — they may have married just before this date or in a different parish.
- **No death or burial record found** for John Telfer or Elspeth Young.
- **Parents unknown** — the next generation back is unconfirmed. Likely Telfer families in Castleton include William Telfer, George Telfer, and James Telfer — but no direct link has been established.
